mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/359382178a9e-t2/ws/prep; cat > /srv/leakruns/359382178a9e-t2/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_0B14 모델링 준비: 예측 시점(tp) 생성, 코호트, 결과, 특성, 분할 키 구성.
모델 학습·성능 계산은 하지 않는다. 설계서/데이터는 읽기만 한다."""
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
D = WS / "data"
OUT = WS / "prep"
design = json.load(open(WS / "design_0B14.json"))
H = pd.Timedelta(hours=1)

p = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
a = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
l = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])
o = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])

# 1) 예측 시점: 입원 후 24..168h, 해당 시점에 아직 입원 중인 경우만
tps = []
for off in design["tp"]["offsets_h"]:
    t = a[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time", "discharge_time", "unit"]].copy()
    t["offset_h"] = off
    t["tp"] = t.admit_time + off * H
    tps.append(t)
tp = pd.concat(tps, ignore_index=True)
n_all = len(tp)
tp = tp[tp.tp < tp.discharge_time].copy()
tp["index_id"] = tp.admission_id + "_" + tp.offset_h.astype(str)
tp = tp.merge(p, on="patient_id", how="left")
# family_id 결측 환자는 단독 가족으로 취급
tp["family_id"] = tp.family_id.fillna("SOLO_" + tp.patient_id)

cr = l[l.test == "creatinine"].sort_values("collect_time")
cr_by_adm = {k: g for k, g in cr.groupby("admission_id")}

def kdigo_events(g):
    """g: 한 입원의 크레아티닌. 각 검사가 KDIGO 기준을 만족하는지(직전 48h +0.3, 직전 7일 최솟값 x1.5)."""
    t = g.collect_time.values; v = g.value.values
    flag = np.zeros(len(g), bool)
    for i in range(len(g)):
        prev48 = (t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(48, "h"))
        prev7 = (t < t[i]) & (t >= t[i] - np.timedelta64(168, "h"))
        if prev48.any() and v[i] - v[prev48].min() >= 0.3: flag[i] = True
        if prev7.any() and v[i] >= 1.5 * v[prev7].min(): flag[i] = True
    return flag

def aki_known(row):
    g = cr_by_adm.get(row.admission_id)
    if g is None: return False
    g = g[g.report_time <= row.tp]   # tp 시점에 결과가 나온 것만 사용
    return bool(kdigo_events(g).any()) if len(g) else False

def aki_outcome(row):
    g = cr_by_adm.get(row.admission_id)
    if g is None: return 0, 0
    g = g[(g.collect_time >= row.tp - 168 * H) & (g.collect_time < row.tp + 48 * H)]
    f = kdigo_events(g)
    inwin = (g.collect_time >= row.tp).values
    return int((f & inwin).any()), int(inwin.sum())

# 2) 코호트
tp = tp[tp.age >= 18]
n_adult = len(tp)
tp["aki_known_by_tp"] = tp.apply(aki_known, axis=1)
cohort = tp[~tp.aki_known_by_tp].copy()

# 3) 결과
res = cohort.apply(aki_outcome, axis=1, result_type="expand")
cohort["aki_48h"] = res[0]; cohort["n_cr_outcome_window"] = res[1]

# 4) 특성 (설계서 그대로)
def lab_feat(test, start_h, agg, name):
    sub = l[l.test == test][["admission_id", "value", "report_time"]]
    m = cohort[["index_id", "admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]].merge(sub, on="admission_id")
    lo = m.admit_time if start_h is None else m.tp - start_h * H
    m = m[(m.report_time >= lo) & (m.report_time <= m.tp)].sort_values("report_time")
    gb = m.groupby("index_id").value
    s = {"last": gb.last, "min": gb.min, "max": gb.max, "count": gb.size}[agg]()
    cohort[name] = cohort.index_id.map(s)
    if agg == "count": cohort[name] = cohort[name].fillna(0).astype(int)

lab_feat("bun", None, "last", "bun_last")
lab_feat("creatinine", None, "count", "n_cr")
lab_feat("potassium", None, "last", "k_last")
lab_feat("creatinine", 48, "max", "cr_max_48h")
lab_feat("hemoglobin", None, "min", "hgb_min")
lab_feat("creatinine", None, "min", "cr_min_adm")
lab_feat("creatinine", None, "last", "cr_last")
ro = o[o.order_type.isin(["dialysis_order", "nephrology_consult"])]
m = cohort[["index_id", "admission_id", "admit_time", "tp"]].merge(ro, on="admission_id")
m = m[(m.order_time >= m.admit_time) & (m.order_time <= m.tp)]
cohort["renal_ordered"] = cohort.index_id.isin(m.index_id).astype(int)

feat_names = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["index_id", "admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "offset_h", "tp", "aki_48h",
        "n_cr_outcome_window"] + feat_names
cohort = cohort[cols]

# 5) 분할: 가족 단위 group holdout (설계서 split.key=index_id 대신 family_id 사용 — 보고서 참조)
rng = np.random.default_rng(design["split"]["seed"])
fams = np.sort(cohort.family_id.unique()); rng.shuffle(fams)
test_f = set(fams[: int(round(len(fams) * design["split"]["test_fraction"]))])
cohort["split"] = np.where(cohort.family_id.isin(test_f), "test", "train")

cohort.to_csv(OUT / "dataset_0B14.csv.gz", index=False)
summary = dict(n_tp_all=n_all, n_tp_in_hospital=int(n_adult), n_cohort=len(cohort),
               n_excluded_aki_known=int(n_adult - len(cohort)),
               n_admissions=int(cohort.admission_id.nunique()), n_patients=int(cohort.patient_id.nunique()),
               n_families=int(cohort.family_id.nunique()),
               split_rows=cohort.split.value_counts().to_dict())
json.dump(summary, open(OUT / "summary.json", "w"), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1, default=str)
print(summary)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
l=pd.read_csv('data/labs.csv.gz',parse_dates=['collect_time','report_time']);o=pd.read_csv('data/orders.csv.gz',parse_dates=['order_time'])
cr=l[l.test=='creatinine'].sort_values('collect_time')
def first_aki(g):
    t=g.collect_time.values;v=g.value.values
    for i in range(len(g)):
        p48=(t<t[i])&(t>=t[i]-np.timedelta64(48,'h'));p7=(t<t[i])&(t>=t[i]-np.timedelta64(168,'h'))
        if (p48.any() and v[i]-v[p48].min()>=0.3) or (p7.any() and v[i]>=1.5*v[p7].min()):
            return pd.Series({'c':g.collect_time.iloc[i],'r':g.report_time.iloc[i]})
    return pd.Series({'c':pd.NaT,'r':pd.NaT})
fa=cr.groupby('admission_id').apply(first_aki).dropna()
ro=o[o.order_type.isin(['dialysis_order','nephrology_consult'])].merge(fa,left_on='admission_id',right_index=True,how='left')

x['d']=(x.order_time-x.c).dt.total_seconds()/3600
print(x.groupby('order_type').d.describe())
print('order before AKI collect:',(x.order_time<x.c).mean(),' between collect & report:',((x.order_time>=x.c)&(x.order_time<x.r)).mean())
# other order types for comparison
oo=o.merge(fa,left_on='admission_id',right_index=True,how='left')
print(oo.groupby('order_type').c.apply(lambda s:s.notna().mean()))
print('base AKI admission rate', len(fa)/l.admission_id.nunique())
